title: Commercial Suit for Permanent Injunction against Trademark Infringement, Passing Off, and Damages
whenToUse: Use when filing a formal commercial suit before District Commercial Court or High Court for permanent injunction, delivery up, and punitive damages against intellectual property infringement.
variantComparisonNote: Commercial plaint with Statement of Truth under Commercial Courts Act, 2015. Distinct from pre-litigation cease and desist notice.
youWillNeed: Legal proceedings certificate (LPC) from Trademark Registry, original invoices showing sales, certified copy of search report, Section 63 BSA certificate for digital captures.
legalBasis: Sections 28, 29, 134, 135 Trade Marks Act, 1999; Order VII Rule 1 CPC, 1908; Commercial Courts Act, 2015; Section 63 Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023.
mandatoryStatutoryIngredients: Jurisdiction invoked under Section 134(2) of Trade Marks Act (Plaintiff's residence/business)
Commercial dispute definition satisfied under Section 2(1)(c) Commercial Courts Act
Urgent interim relief sought under Order XXXIX Rules 1 & 2 read with Section 12A exemption
Statement of Truth verified under Order VI Rule 15A CPC

particulars.description: Designation of Commercial Court / High Court

particulars.description: Valuation of suit for court fees and damages

aiBlocks.title: Plaintiff's Brand Equity & Statutory Rights
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Narrate Plaintiff's prior adoption, statutory trademark registrations under Section 28 Trade Marks Act, 1999, marketing expenditure, and goodwill.

aiBlocks.title: Infringing Conduct & Passing Off
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Demonstrate Defendant's infringing conduct under Section 29, identical goods/services, phonetic and ocular similarity, and deception of the trade and public.

aiBlocks.title: Prayers for Injunction, Delivery Up & Damages
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Draft comprehensive prayers for permanent injunction, destruction and delivery up of dies/stocks, rendition of accounts under Section 135, and damages of ₹{{FACT:suit_valuation_amount}}/-.
